PHOTOGRAPHER OF THE REAL MOMENTS 




 A LOVER OF LIFE, COLOR, AND ALL THINGS FUN.




Hi I'm Gabrielle, but you can call me Gabby. I've had a passion for photography since I was in high school, and it has only grown stronger since then. I am always the friend who has a camera roll of photos and is always documenting what we are doing. I've taken that desire to document life, not just for my friends and me but for you as well. Whether you're graduating from high school, college, getting engaged or getting married, or simply needing a new profile picture, I'm your girl. 

READ MORE
Alabama-based, 
Travel Ready﻿

I am located in central and southeast Alabama, but I love traveling. I've always wanted to do something where I could see more of this beautiful world, and photography is that for me. If you are a couple of hours away or a plane ride away, I'll meet you where you are and capture those special moments for you. Reach out about how my pricing varies based on travel!
